google._comment: Buat di https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client IDs → Web application. Tambahkan redirect URI: http://localhost:55501/api/auth/callback/google

discord._comment: Buat di https://discord.com/developers/applications → OAuth2 → Redirects: http://localhost:55501/api/auth/callback/discord → Scopes: identify, email
